_about: Reviewed by a person, read by scripts/fetch-local-names.py. <country>: place id -> {name, source}. The name is the source spelling in the local script (NFC, no edge zero-width spaces) and the source is the local-language Wikipedia page or the Wikidata item it came from. Accepted when the article is the place itself or the main venue named in the place card's title. rejected: place id -> why a candidate was refused, so a rerun never offers it again: a surrounding district, province, town or island, an activity, a dish, a different spelling in Wikipedia and Wikidata, or no article of its own.
